game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart, the glowing heart of the ruins: the rune scholar must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of relic shards while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Eldritch Heart: the glowing heart of the ruins
core_gameplay_loop: In Eldritch Heart, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of relic shards while keeping the order. Each round, rune wisps strike the crypt seal, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the crypt seal from rune wisps in Eldritch Heart: keep the clean_list meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: clean_list drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Duplicate Sweep' (Week 7 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Eldritch Heart'.
